Tired of stitching together voice infrastructure, chat SDKs, and container supervisors just to build a functional AI assistant? 

Meet OpenDots: an open-source template for building always-on AI coworkers that seamlessly transition between web chat, live voice calls, and Slack. 🚀

Most AI assistants are fragmented. They live in a single chat window and lack the tools or context to do real work. OpenDots solves this by providing a unified, self-hostable workspace where persistent AI agents—called Dots—operate across multiple modalities with total context continuity.

🔥 Key Developer Features:
• Specialist Dots with Dedicated Computers: Each agent runs in an isolated container with persistent browser profiles and workspace files, controlled via granular permissions.
• Omnichannel Continuity: Seamlessly bridge text chat, real-time voice calls via WebRTC, and managed Slack channels using the Channels SDK.
• Human-in-the-Loop Safeguards: Built-in approval cards pause agent tool execution for your review before writing files or running critical actions.
• AG-UI and CopilotKit Integration: Stream agent state, render live browser activity, and manage durable conversation threads out of the box.

Whether you are deploying internal automation agents or building specialized research assistants that browse the web and report back via voice, OpenDots gives you a production-ready foundation.

👉 Check out the repo and start building:
https://github.com/CopilotKit/OpenDots

Clone the template today and let us know what kind of AI coworker you are spinning up in the comments below! 👇

Turn messy, JavaScript-heavy web pages into clean LLM-ready markdown and structured JSON instantly with Firecrawl! 🚀

Are you tired of wasting dozens of hours managing headless browsers, proxy rotations, and brittle DOM parsers just to feed web data into your AI pipelines? 

Building RAG systems, market research bots, and autonomous agents shouldn't mean fighting with complex web scraping infrastructure. 

Firecrawl acts as a comprehensive web-to-data utility that converts unstructured websites into clean, token-efficient markdown, structured JSON, or media files. It completely eliminates the headaches of JavaScript rendering, rate-limiting, and browser automation.

Key Features Built for Developers:
• LLM-Ready & Multi-Format Output: Get clean markdown optimized for low token consumption, plus structured JSON via Pydantic schemas, screenshots, and raw HTML.
• Autonomous Agent Capabilities: Use the Agent endpoint for natural language data discovery without hardcoding URLs, and the Interact endpoint to click, scroll, and type on live pages.
• Deep Site Discovery: Enjoy instantaneous site mapping, single-request crawling, and async batch scraping for thousands of URLs with 96% web coverage.
• Native MCP Integration: Single-command installation as a Model Context Protocol server or CLI skill to instantly give autonomous agents real-time web capabilities.

Whether you are powering real-time RAG pipelines with live documentation or building autonomous market intelligence agents that navigate multi-page applications, Firecrawl replaces custom scripts with a high-performance API and native SDKs.

👉 Check out the repo and start scraping smarter: https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl

Want to build native-feeling ChatGPT plugins and extensions using OpenAI's official Model Context Protocol extensions toolkit? 🚀

Building advanced AI tools often means sacrificing seamless frontend integration. Traditional Model Context Protocol servers give you backend context, but bridging that data into a rich, interactive user experience inside ChatGPT has always been a major roadblock for developers. 

OpenAI MCP Extensions solves this by extending the Model Context Protocol with ChatGPT-specific capabilities. It empowers you to build plugins, custom UI entrypoints, and file viewers that integrate fluidly directly into the ChatGPT interface.

🔥 Notable Features:
• Sidebar Entrypoints: Give users direct access to your application right from the ChatGPT sidebar.
• Custom File Handlers: Render specialized file viewers dynamically when specific file types are opened.
• Composer Mentions: Enable users to search plugin resources and add references inline within chat messages.
• Extended Form Elicitation: Support rich input elements like thumbnail image pickers for advanced workflows.

Whether you are creating domain-specific CAD and technical file viewers or building enterprise knowledge base tools with rich sidebar access, this toolkit bridges the gap between backend AI context tools and immersive frontend UI experiences using TypeScript and Python SDKs.

👉 Check out the repo and start building today: https://github.com/openai/mcp-extensions

What happens when you run Minecraft hidden inside Skyrim using shared memory? 🤯

SkyCraft is an astonishing cross-genre engineering feat that embeds a hidden Minecraft instance inside Skyrim via shared memory, allowing you to walk, mine, and build voxel structures directly on Skyrim terrain.

The Problem:
Bridging two completely disparate game engines (Bethesda's Creation Engine via SKSE and Minecraft via Fabric) into a single cohesive runtime experience is a massive architectural hurdle. Instead of rewriting either game, SkyCraft runs Minecraft hidden in the background while feeding Skyrim's collision, terrain data, and NPC interactions into Minecraft's physics loop, rendering Minecraft blocks and HUD elements natively inside Skyrim's graphics frame.

Notable Features:
• Shared Memory Inter-Process Architecture: Coordinates a C++ SKSE plugin and a Java Fabric mod running simultaneously, managing state, positioning, and rendering across boundaries.
• Bidirectional Physics and Collision Sync: Skyrim's terrain, buildings, and ground geometry are fed into Minecraft's collision engine, while Minecraft explosions and block destruction carve real holes and craters directly into Skyrim's world.
• Integrated Progression Translation: Minecraft gameplay activities directly trigger Skyrim skill level-ups, mapping actions like mining and weapon swings to traditional Skyrim attributes like One-Handed, Smithing, and Heavy Armor.
• Peer-to-Peer Multiplayer Support: Leverages embedded networking to allow up to 100 players to share the same Minecraft world while maintaining their individual Skyrim saves.

For systems programmers, reverse engineers, and game engine devs, this codebase is a masterclass in low-level systems interoperability, showing how native C++ plugins can hook into closed-source commercial runtimes and orchestrate real-time data exchange with Java.

Check out the code and dive into the architecture on GitHub:
https://github.com/chasmlol/SkyCraft

Powering the daily workflows of millions of engineers, the Code - OSS repository remains the gold standard for extensible, high-performance developer tooling. 💻

Building software shouldn't mean constantly fighting your tools. Visual Studio Code solves the core friction of the edit-build-debug cycle by combining a lightweight, high-performance source code editor with deep language intelligence, integrated debugging, and a vast extensible architecture.

🚀 Notable features include:
• Comprehensive code editing and navigation supporting syntax highlighting, code completion, and deep semantic code understanding across dozens of languages.
• A powerful and robust extensibility model that allows developers to build custom language features, debug adapters, themes, and tooling via dedicated APIs.
• Built-in Git and source control management integration for seamless branching, committing, and resolving conflicts directly within the editor.
• First-class Dev Containers and GitHub Codespaces support, enabling instant, reproducible cloud and containerized development environments.

Whether you want to study how a massive, performance-critical desktop application is architected using Electron and TypeScript, contribute directly to core performance enhancements, or build custom extensions for your team, this is where the magic happens.

👉 Check out the repo and drop a star: https://github.com/microsoft/vscode
